title: [Bug] Numpad key codes returning incorrect escape sequences
body:
**Bug Description**
when I click on my numpad pressing any digits this is happening:

1 = [57400u
enter = [57414u

before this wasn't happening, there is some issue going on, I have a logitech full keyboard and this is happening when I use the numpad

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.1.2
- Feedback ID: 96b9192b-b049-4ed2-9eb7-3ebb67e2db9f
author: andersonaguiar

top_comments.author: blois
top_comments.body: This should be fixed on the latest version.

top_comments.author: oborchers
top_comments.body: Please fix - this is so annoying

top_comments.author: mwhitis
top_comments.body: It looks like there are a couple of issues for this, so just adding a +1 for them.
